verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for a travel-and-expense SaaS platform, but the evidence never documents a recurring schedule, cron, or scheduled-report feature. The closest items are approval-policy workflows, polling async job status, webhooks, and on-demand MCP queries. These are adjacent features or one-off actions, not recurring scheduling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
